summary: Executed backend+frontend verification for ERP reset/seed/report scope on public preview. Core ERP health flow works (score 93, PDF links work, audit logs include reset-correction path), but two backend regressions remain in seeded accounting dataset and expense retrieval.

critical.issue: Returns 500 for seeded clean expense document. Backend log shows Pydantic ValidationError: missing required field total_deductions when hydrating Expense response.
Seed clean dataset currently returns 4 active entries instead of required 5; source_type=deposit_interest entry is missing.

minor.issue: Lockout policy observed as 3 failed attempts -> 429 on 4th attempt. If expected policy is 5 attempts, this is a mismatch; if expected policy is 3 (current docs), behavior is correct.

action_items: Fix seeded expense document shape or hydration defaults so GET /api/expenses/{id} never 500s (ensure total_deductions/net_amount exist or are derived safely).
Regenerate/repair clean dataset to include exactly 5 active entries with required source types: opening_balance, deposit, deposit_interest, revenue, expense.
After fixes, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iteration82_erp_reset_seed_health_report.py and confirm 9/9 passing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains very large (>700 lines, currently ~9800), increasing regression risk. Prioritize modular split to routers/services for accounting, auth, reporting.
Expense response model is stricter than real stored documents; add migration/backfill or defensive hydration to prevent runtime validation 500s on historical/seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression test file already added for this request. Re-run the same file after main-agent fixes. UI ERP page currently loads and shows score/metrics/recommendations with visible direct download button.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (/api/expenses/{id}): Repro by logging in as admin and GET seeded expense id from journal entry source_id. API crashes in get_expense -> Expense(**hydrate_expense(document)) because stored seeded expense lacks required total_deductions field (ValidationError). Mitigation: backfill missing fields in seeded docs and/or make hydration compute defaults. RCA-2 (Seed count mismatch): Repro by GET /api/journal-entries in social-solidarity after reset. Returned 4 approved active entries only; required deposit_interest source_type not present. Mitigation: include deposit_interest journal entry generation in reset/seed pipeline and verify via regression test before handoff.
